source: Theoretical residency is limited by launch configuration and resources. Active warps are resident. Eligible warps are active warps that are not stalled. Issued warps are those actually selected to send an instruction. Nsight notes that cycles with no eligible warp lead to skipped issue opportunities and indicate poor latency hiding.[3]
zh: 理论驻留时间受到启动配置和资源的限制。活动扭曲是常驻的。合格的扭曲是未停滞的活动扭曲。发出的扭曲是那些实际选择发送指令的扭曲。 Nsight 指出，没有合格扭曲的周期会导致跳过问题机会，并表明延迟隐藏效果不佳。 [3]
